meaning:
γόνυ, -ατος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for בֶּרֶךְ ;]
the knee: Heb.12:12; of a suppliant, προσπίπτειν τοῖς γ., Luk.5:8; so also τιθέναι τὰ γ., to kneel: Luk.22:41, Act.7:60 9:40 20:36 21:5; in mockery, Mrk.15:19; κάμπτειν τὰ γ., to bend the knee: Rom.11:4 (LXX) 14:11 (LXX), Eph.3:14, Php.2:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
